title: Customer issue reporting notifications + admin past/expired bookings highlighting

requirements.text: Ensure customers have a clearly visible "Report an Issue" action for each of their bookings, and that submitting an issue creates an admin notification categorized as "issues" with a distinct (issue-specific) color treatment in the admin Notifications panel.

quotes: add report an issue button for customers and let it display in notifications in admin in different colour

acceptanceCriteria: On the customer "My Bookings" page, each booking card provides a "Report Issue" action that opens the existing ReportIssueDialog.
Submitting the issue successfully shows the customer success message and persists the issue via existing issueStorage.
Submitting an issue adds a permanent admin notification with category "issues" (via existing addPermanentNotification usage).

In the admin NotificationPanel, issue notifications are grouped under the "issues" category and are visually distinct from other categories (e.g., red icon/badge/left accent bar as implemented for 'issues').
At least one issue notification created from the customer flow appears in the admin NotificationPanel without requiring a page reload (i.e., updates via the existing storage/event listeners).

requirements.text: Update the admin Booking Management view to clearly include previous (past) bookings and visually distinguish expired bookings using a different color treatment from active bookings.

quotes: and also let admin see prev bookings too expired bookings should be in different colour

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Booking Management shows both upcoming/active bookings and past bookings (no past bookings are hidden/omitted).
A booking is considered "expired" when its checkOutDate is earlier than the current time (client time).
Expired bookings are visually differentiated (e.g., muted/grey card styling and/or an "Expired" badge with a distinct color) while keeping existing status badges (confirmed/pending/cancelled) intact.
Expired styling is applied consistently to every expired booking in the list.
The bookings summary/counts remain correct and continue to reflect underlying booking.status values as before.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components); compose them instead.
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain single-actor; only introduce backend changes if strictly necessary (this request can be satisfied with the existing localStorage-based issue/notification flows).
nonGoals: Implementing real-time push notifications or WebSocket updates.
Changing the booking schema in a way that requires state migration.
